about: What the camera frames in a fight: Target with Targets, Position, Distance, CameraDistance, TargetMode, ZoomToDistance, SetPlayerTargets and flags. Script Extender: CameraCombatTarget.

evidence.says: Script Extender declares ecl::camera::CombatTargetComponent::Target at +0x0 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Camera.h:338): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types. Not checked against the game's code.
the game's executable keeps this type name among its ECS type names (gatekit symbols types)
on the level Basic_Level_A, outside a fight, it sits on the camera entity with SetPlayerTargets true, TargetMode 1, Flags 1, Distance and CameraDistance -1, ZoomToDistance false
reported from the study of the camera focus, not read again here: the engine acts on it only when it is marked changed, and on the own turn of the player a write is copied and not obeyed

survey.names: Every name here is Script Extender's author's (his headers), not the game's own: they are kept because they are what the extender's Lua answers to and what bg3_verify compares, and every field carries the rung `extender` - the extender's name for the field at that offset, which nobody has checked against the game's code. A name is raised from `extender` only with evidence from the code, by `gatekit names set`.
